title: Hollingsworth's 28-point eruption seals back-to-back crown for Petrolina AEK
description: Petrolina AEK successfully defended their ECOMMBX Basket League championship on Monday, holding off a furious late rally from Keravnos Strovolou to win 68-64 in Game 5 of the finals at the Kition Arena and claim the title 3-2 in front of approximately 4,000 fans. Taveion Hollingsworth (188-G-1999, college: WKU) was the driving force with a game-high 28 points, including a clutch fourth-quarter performance that kept AEK ahead when Keravnos closed within a single point in the dying seconds. Jayveous McKinnis (201-F-1999, college: Ole Miss) added 16 points and Ta'Lon Cooper (193-G-1999, college: S.Carolina) had 12, including the composed free throws and a Reed Nottage (198-G, college: CBU) dunk in the closing seconds that sealed the championship for coach Christoforos Liavadiotis' side.
imageCaption: Hollingsworth's 28-point eruption seals back-to-back crown for Petrolina AEK(Photo: cbf.basketball)

title: Petrolina AEK sweep Keravnos to secure OPAP BL title
description: AEK Larnaca - Keravnos 99-94 Petrolina AEK outlasted Keravnos in an overtime tonight and therefore swept the championship series. AEK Larnaca made 26-of-34 free shots (76.5 percent) during the game. 26 personal fouls committed by Keravnos helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. The best player for the winners was American Amir Bell (193-1996, college: Princeton) who scored 38 points (!!!). His fellow American import guard Taveion Hollingsworth (188-1999, college: WKU) chipped in 30 points. At the other side the best for losing team was American guard Josh Hagins (187-1994, college: UALR, agency: Haylett Sports) who recorded a double-double by scoring 24 points, 7 rebounds and 10 assists and the former international point guard Filippos Tigkas (184-2002) added 33 points (!!!) and 5 rebounds respectively. title: Keravnos clinch OPAP Basket League title
description: AEK Larnaca - Keravnos 77-84 Keravnos are crowned OPAP BL champions. They upset AEK Larnaca in the decisive fifth game of the championship series on the road. The guests took control from the first minutes by winning the initial quarter 23-17. But AEK Larnaca won second period 22-20. However it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. Keravnos looked well-organized offensively handing out 26 assists. American players dominated the game. Point guard Shavar Reynolds Jr (188-1998, college: Monmouth, agency: Octagon Europe) orchestrated the victory by scoring 25 points, 5 rebounds and 7 assists. Center Travis Taylor (203-1990, college: Xavier, agency: Slash Sports) contributed with a double-double by scoring 19 points and 14 rebounds for the winners. title: AEK Larnaca are 22/23 OPAP Basket League winners
description: Keravnos - AEK Larnaca 70-72 Petrolina AEK claimed 22/23 OPAP Basket League title. They overcame Keravnos in the decisive fifth game of the championship series. Taveion Hollingsworth (188-G-1999, college: WKU) was pivotal with 28 points to lead the champions. Keravnos eked out a 15-14 lead after ten minutes. AEK surged ahead in the second frame. The visitors grabbed a 34-31 halftime advantage. AEK extended the lead in the third quarter. They built a 55-48 advantage at the final intermission. AEK stayed in front throughout the fourth period and clinched a decisive victory at the end. Tookie Brown (180-PG-1995, college: Georgia South, agency: Verus Management) posted 18 points for the winners. Deondre Burns (190-G-1997, college: ORU, agency: Haylett Sports) answered with 29 points for Keravnos. Ousman Krubally (201-PF-1988, college: Georgia St.) had 10 points and 13 rebounds in the defeat.
imageCaption: AEK Larnaca are 22/23 OPAP Basket League winners (Photo: Twitter/@AEKLARNACA)

title: AEK Larnaca celebrate OPAP Basket League title
description: Keravnos - AEK Larnaca 65-72 AEK Larnaca clinched OPAP Basket League title. They beat Keravnos in the decisive fifth game of the championship series to conquer the trophy. The guests trailed by 1 point after three quarters before their 18-10 charge, which allowed them to win the game. Canadian-Nigerian forward Derek Ogbeide (203-97, college: Georgia) stepped up with a double-double by scoring 22 points and 17 rebounds for the winners and American guard Quentin Snider (188-95, college: Louisville, agency: GoEmpire Group) chipped in 15 points, 5 rebounds and 6 assists. Four AEK Larnaca players scored in double figures. American power forward Andre Williamson (203-89, college: App State) responded with a double-double by scoring 15 points and 10 rebounds and the other American import guard Brandon Rozzell (188-89, college: VCU) scored 17 points and 4 assists.
imageCaption: AEK Larnaca celebrate OPAP Basket League title (Photo: aek.com.cy)
